figurative_meaning_en: Afflicted with various kinds of wounds or diseases
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আঠারো ঘায় ভুগছে, কোনো ওষুধই কাজ করে না।
জীবনের চাপে তার আঠারো ঘা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is suffering from eighteen wounds; no medicine works on him.
The stress of life has left him afflicted with various ailments.
history: This idiom originates from rural folklore, implying that even a mere touch from a tiger (বাঘে ছুঁলে) results in multiple wounds, symbolizing severe affliction from a minor incident.
note: The variant আটারো refers to seventeen, but আঠারো (eighteen) is the standard form emphasizing exaggeration.
